title: A protected boundary
hook: A migrating animal’s route can cross a boundary.

knows: Animals depend on features of their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A toy migration route begins inside a protected area and ends outside it. Which part is outside that area?

misconception: A single observation or change determines the same outcome everywhere.
objective: A toy migration route begins inside a protected area and ends outside it. Which part is outside that area?

claims.text: A toy migration route begins inside a protected area and ends outside it. Which part is outside that area? The highlighted area marks the protected boundary; the arrow extends beyond it. Only the segment inside lies within that protected area. A protected area can help along part of a migration, but its boundary does not establish protection everywhere on the route.
claims.source: Stipulated illustrative scenario, not wildlife observations. Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The panels show a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A migrating bird flies beyond a protected area boundary. Is that segment inside the same protected area? The part beyond the drawn boundary lies outside that area.

recall.question: A migrating bird flies beyond a protected area boundary. Is that segment inside the same protected area?
options: Only if the bird can fly
